t: In front of you is the Animals in War Memorial, in Hyde Park. It commemorates the countless animals that have served and died under British military command throughout history. The sculptor was David Backhouse, an English artist born in 1941, who made the work. It was unveiled in November 2004 by Anne, Princess Royal. Take a moment to look at how the figures are arranged, and think about the animals the memorial honours, who had no choice in the wars they were part of.
